'''302nd Flight Wing''' was a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] unit in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]]. The [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] was the home base of this unit.
